findings.finding: Exact node_find_indicated_socket differs in UI namespace and collapsed-node exclusions; ordinary expanded single-input/output corridor retains max-distance, padded size, header exclusion, visibility, nearest distance and occlusion logic. This does not prove identical draw geometry, UI units, runtime locations, scaling or device acquisition.

Stock adds input-side collapsed resize exclusions. Stock output-side excludes inward x distance above NODE_SOCKSIZE and corner region with y beyond NODE_SOCKSIZE; target output-side only tests inward x above padded_socket_size. Host probes should keep expanded nodes and explicitly record hide/collapsed state.

Input init with existing link copies then removes original native tree link. Output init also detaches existing links when at socket capacity or detach=true. Native Cancel deactivates tooltip, restores edge-pan, destroys drag data, clears highlight, tags and updates invariants; it does not reinsert original links. This is source control-flow evidence, not an observed device defect or generic rollback claim.

Confirm consults stored dragged endpoints; no socket repick on release. It may create link-search popup, adds only complete links, resolves occupied socket links and updates invariants. Fresh empty drag and existing-input empty detach therefore require distinct native probes.

Production wm_operator_finished is exact target upstream; stock only changes HUD namespaces. NODE_OT_link retains REGISTER|UNDO|BLOCKING. FINISHED can push native Link Nodes undo at zero nesting depth and registers operator; CANCELLED follows direct free/cleanup rather than that finished push. Production handler has separate existing input policies, so only normal Node corridor is compared.

Production ED_undo_push/push_op/step_pre/step_post/step_direction exact upstream and stock. Selected BKE push/undo/redo/load and encode/decode wrappers exact target-stock. Memfile decode differs: legacy setting moves experimental to developer tools; preview restart and sequencer/compositor depsgraph handling change; stock adds sculpt mesh update mitigation. Stock snapshot execution remains stock evidence, even for plain object-mode Shader graph.

Stock graph add/remove uses MEM_new/MEM_delete versus target calloc/malloc/free. Stock bNodeLink defines nullptr/zero defaults for link fields. Typed list iteration and casts differ without a selected branch policy change.

Socket NODE_DY/NODE_DYS/NODE_SOCKSIZE/multi-input gap macros match exactly. Reverse node draw helper retains descending ui_order comparator but uses std::ranges::sort instead of std::sort in stock. Dynamic full node layout and runtime location writes remain unaudited by this bounded report.
